routes.name: Visitor Permit (on arrival)
routes.summary: Visitors from visa-exempt countries get a visitor permit on arrival, up to 4 months. You can't work on it. Check the official visa-exempt list for your passport.

other: Passport from a visa-exempt country (see official list)
Return ticket, proof of funds, confirmed address in Fiji
Medical-treatment travelers and yacht/carrier crew must get approval before arriving

stay.note: Can be extended by up to 2 months for a fee.

routes.name: Single and Multiple Entry Visa
routes.summary: Needed if your country isn't visa-exempt. Apply online before you go. Single entry is valid 3 months. Multiple entry is valid 12 months, with stays up to 4 months each.

other: Only for nationals of non-exempt countries
Proof of funds, itinerary or ticket, hotel booking or local sponsor letter

stay.note: Single entry visa valid 3 months. Multiple entry visa valid 12 months, each stay max 4 months.

routes.processing: About 14 working days from receipt, per the Ministry.

routes.name: Business Visitor Permit
routes.summary: Short permit for business visits. Valid 21 days and can't be extended. Longer work needs a work permit.

other: Letter of invitation from a local organization
Return ticket and evidence of funds
The Department may grant 30 days at its discretion

steps: Email the application with the documents to the address on the Ministry page
routes.processing: 2 to 24 hours depending on completeness, per the Ministry.

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: If you continue to another country within 72 hours of entry, you need a transit visa applied for before arriving, plus proof of the next visa and an onward ticket.

other: Approved visa for next destination
Onward ticket
Fee not listed on the pages we read

routes.name: Work Permit
routes.summary: Employer-sponsored work permits. Long-term is 3 years. Short-term is a year or less. There are also categories for overseas employees, NGOs, maritime and fishing, and secondments.

other: A locally registered employer must apply
Employment contract with required clauses and minimum wage
You can't apply from inside Fiji on a visitor permit
Specialized jobs need endorsement from the relevant authority

stay.note: Short-term permits run a year or less.

fees.label: Work permit application, extension or variation

routes.processing: Standard 21 working days. Apply for extensions 30 days before expiry.

routes.name: Student Permit
routes.summary: Needed to study in Fiji. Apply from outside the country. Some regional nationals are exempt. You can't work on it.

other: Apply from outside Fiji
Exemptions for students from certain regional countries

routes.name: Residence Permit on Assured Income
routes.summary: For people 45 or older with income or assets outside Fiji. Valid 3 years. You first get 6 months, then the rest once you remit and/or buy property worth FJD 100,000. No work allowed.

investment.note: Remittance and/or property purchase to get the full term

other: Reliable income or assets outside Fiji
Dependants: legal spouse and children under 18
No employment or business in Fiji

stay.note: 6 months first, then 2.5 years after the FJD 100,000 requirement is met.

routes.name: Family and Exemption Status Permits
routes.summary: Special permits to live with a family member who holds a permit, plus exemption status for spouses and children of Fiji citizens and former citizens. Details are on the Ministry's permit pages.

other: Spouse or child of a Fiji citizen, or dependant of a permit holder
Exact requirements and fees not confirmed here

routes.name: Asylum and Refugee Status
routes.summary: Refugee status is handled through the Ministry of Immigration. See the official page for the process.

routes.name: Fiji Citizenship
routes.summary: Citizenship by birth, registration, or naturalization. Naturalization is on hold pending the Citizenship (Amendment) Regulations 2026. Dual citizenship is allowed.

other: Naturalization currently on hold
Residence years and tests not confirmed from official pages

citizenship.note: Routes: birth, registration, naturalization. Naturalization on hold.
